Hi Camila —

Thanks for the invoice and attachments. Quick note from our side: our AP cycle for vendor invoices is Net-45 for services, and the next run will pay on 10/30. That said, we can prioritize a partial wire for 50% if you can provide an explicit remittance reference and the bank details in the format our treasury system requires.

Also: we prefer to push card payments through our virtual-card vendor for the balance. Two asks before we proceed:
1) Can you confirm Redwood’s supplier ID or remit reference string we should include?
2) Please confirm the W-9 EIN and add a PO number (we will attach PO-ORION-7783 when we route).

If you can accept the split (50% wire by 10/06, remainder via virtual card by 10/20), we can route documents to treasury and AP today.
